reviews.comment: Do yourself a favor and take a class from her. All you need to do is attend each class, be engaged, put in the effort for the papers, and this class will be an easy A. Professor Sweet is genuinely such a great professor and listening to her lectures was never a chore.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Sweet is amazing. If you don't attend you won't pass, not because shell fail you but because you won't understand the material without her amazing explanations. she assigns a lot of reading but I almost read non of it because paying attention in class was enough. She cares a lot about her students and is very understanding of any circumstances

Solid teacher who clearly cares about the subject, she probably would have been even better as an in person teacher. lectures are interesting also In terms of the class itself it was pretty easy. Show up and pay attention to the class and the quizzes are a breeze. there were 2 essays graded pretty easily TLDR: do everything + 30% effort  A

Take Dr. Sweet! She was great. There are 2 4 page essays, which were a pain, but she allows you to send it in early and she will give you feedback before you have to submit it. Make sure to pay attention to lectures to do well on quizzes (every question you miss on a quiz is a point off your final grade). Good at responding and stays after to talk!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Most amazing professor I have had at TAMU. She's very personable and genuinely cares for her students. Once you know how to write philosophy papers her class is simple and straightforward. Really enjoyed thinking through some of the philosophical concepts together.

I took this class because I needed a culture credit and I was super impressed. I learned a lot about philosophy and actually enjoyed going to class. The lectures are very well thought out and the professor is very easy going. Attendance is not mandatory, but the quizzes are pretty much based on the lecture. No exams, only 2 papers.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: I am taking Dr. Sweet for the second time, that's how good she is. She truly cares whether or not her students are grasping concepts and is always willing to listen to new ideas. She even has the desire to learn from us rather than just teach! She is excellent at utilizing our life examples to connect them to her lessons in an entertaining way.

Great professor that I would recommend to anyone, more focused on discussing topics then memorization. Encourage you to participate in class as it will make quizzes easier. Assignments aren't very difficult, no exams just two papers done online.

Dr. Sweet is a great prof! She makes you think but is great with explanations and making sure you understand the material. Shes open about what she thinks and very respectful about what you think, just be ready to show your thought process! Super discussion based and overall a great intro to Philosophy.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Sweet is so cool and very smart but totally teaches on the students' level. I honestly was dreading having to take a philosophy class (I'm pre-nursing), but she made it so interesting even though philosophy can be hard to grasp. She really cares that you understand and is willing to meet with you to review your paper before it's due. Take her!

I have really enjoyed this class this semester! I have no previous philosophy experience and I was nervous about taking this course but Dr. Sweet is so interesting to listen to and very good at helping me in my understanding of the readings. I truly think this class will have a lasting impact on me & I'm very glad I took this course with her!

Dr. Sweet is my favorite prof ever. She doesn't ever seem like she's talking above her students even though she is extremely articulate & intelligent.  She explains herself very well & shows genuine interest in hearing your ideas during class. She really makes you love learning. You analyze paintings in class & discuss philosophies on art & beauty.

Dr. Sweet's class was great! Her lectures are entirely discussion based and she is very clear in her explanations. Grades consist of 4 papers, which were not that difficult. She is also very approachable and willing to help you. She's pretty big on participation, which I wasn't a big fan of, but other than that, class was enjoyable and not hard.

She was amazing! Very well spoken and highly respectable. She was very good at clarifying things that were confusing during class and was more than willing to work with students outside of class. She only assigned 3 papers for the semester, and they were based entirely on what we talked about in class and the readings.
Dr. Sweet is the best! You will never regret taking a class with her!!

I had her for a free speech course. She's very bright and incredibly interested in the subject. The classes were more like class discussions than lectures and it was always a pleasure. However, had to do the readings. Basically every class a short paper was due. No tests. Just essays.

I don't recommend this class until your junior or senior year, if ever. She seems like a very nice person, just uses a large vocabulary and really doesn't give clear explanations to anything. You will not understand majority of what is going on if you are not fluent in political science and unnecessary large words. A LOT OF READING, YOU MUST READ.
